title: Run Result Read Contract for Observe Source v1
description: Defines the subset of fields read by Observe's RunResultSource from .fgos/assignments/<asgnId>/runs/<runId>/result.json and assignment.json.

runId.description: Identifier of the run, used as subject id.

settledAt.description: Timestamp of settlement, primary timestamp for the observation.

timestamp.description: Fallback timestamp if settledAt is missing.

assignmentId.description: Assignment identifier (fallback to directory name if absent).

assignment.description: Fields read from assignment.json (cached per assignment).

createdAt.description: Assignment creation timestamp, used as ultimate fallback for observation timestamp.
